answer: Each of 90 aliases needs its own billing histories, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. A streaming subscription tenure with billing history works as the gate: a subscription billed monthly to one account for years. The jade check is what stops the copy-paste farm: The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. The signal record is public, the umber cost is per identity, and 90 aliases cost 90 times one honest seat.
